document.abstract: The VHD (Video High Density) system plays a 10.2-in. grooveless conductive plastic disc. Each disc contains one hour per side of high quality, color video programming with stereo sound. The VHD system will also play a digitally recorded, ultra high-fidelity pulse-coded modulated Audio High-Density Disc (AHD). The AHD disc will be available approximately one year after the introduction of the VHD Videodisc system.
